johto_mom_home: Mom: Oh, you look tired, honey!
johto_rival_mom: My son {rival_name} is out exploring Johto right now.
He said he was going to become the greatest Math Master!
You look tired, why don't you rest here for a moment?
Give my regards to your mother in Pallet Town!
johto_mom_neighbor: It's so quiet with him gone...
johto_elm_intro: Professor Elm: Hi! I'm Professor Elm. My lab studies how Pokemon evolve and hatch.
Three young Pokemon here are looking for a trainer: Chikorita, Cyndaquil and Totodile.
johto_elm_errand: Take this Egg back to Professor Elm immediately!
That egg is a true mystery of the world!
johto_elm_congrats: Professor Elm: Incredible! You're the Kanto Champion!
Oak told me all about your math-powered battles.
I've updated your Pokédex to include Johto species.
And I've added a Johto page to your Badge Case!
There is a whole new world of Pokémon to discover!
You received the NATIONAL DEX and JOHTO BADGE CASE!
kurt_intro: Kurt: Team Rocket has taken over the Slowpoke Well!
They're cutting off tails to sell them for profit!
I'm going down there to stop them myself!
Wait... my back! Ouch ouch ouch...
Young trainer, please! Go to the Well and stop those crooks!
kurt_reward: Kurt: You did it! The Slowpoke are safe and their tails are growing back.
Team Rocket won't be bothering Azalea Town for a while.
Please, take this special Lure Ball I made from White Apricorns.
bill_johto_intro: I was just checking on the PC system here in Ecruteak.
You look like a promising math trainer.
If you're ever in Goldenrod, come visit my house!
I have some rare Eevee eggs I'm researching.
lance_mahogany_intro: Lance: I've tracked the source of the high-frequency signal to this shop.
Team Rocket is hiding a massive base beneath Mahogany Town.
They are forcing Pokémon to evolve using artificial radio waves!
I will go ahead and scout. Follow me when you are ready!
lance_mahogany_cleared: Lance: Excellent work. Team Rocket's radio signal has been cut off.
The Dragon's Den in Blackthorn is your next destination.
kimono_girls_intro: We are the Kimono Girls of Ecruteak.
We dance to honor the legends of the towers.
A master of math and heart may one day see the rainbow bird.
jasmine_lighthouse_intro: Jasmine: Amphy is sick and the lighthouse can't shine.
There is a pharmacy in Cianwood City that has a special medicine.
But I cannot leave Amphy alone... please, could you go for me?
You will need to cross the sea. Please, take this SURF BOARD.
jasmine_lighthouse_medicine: Jasmine: You brought the medicine from Cianwood?
Thank you so much! Please, give it to Amphy!
I cannot thank you enough. Math truly connects all hearts.
amphy_cured: The light in its tail begins to glow brightly!
pharmacist_reward: Pharmacist: You came from Olivine for Jasmine's Amphy?
I have just the thing. It's a very strong medicine!
euskine_intro: Euskine: I'm searching for the legendary Suicune.
It is said to be the embodiment of the North Wind.
eusine_suicune_defeated: You tell Eusine about your math-powered victory over Suicune.
Eusine: What?! You actually cornered Suicune in battle?
I've spent years chasing its shadow, and you... you've already faced it with your math!
I'm jealous, but also impressed. Suicune chooses only the most brilliant minds.
I'll continue my search. We will meet again!
dragon_elder_intro: Elder: You must answer the test of the Dragon Den!
Do you treat your Pokémon with love? Or as tools for math?
dragon_elder_pass: Elder: You have proven your compassion and math skill.
The dragon master Clair has much to learn from you.
giovanni_tohjo_intro: Giovanni: How? How can you have found me here?
I am Giovanni, the leader of Team Rocket.
I will not let a child stand in the way of my return!
giovanni_tohjo_won: Giovanni: This math... it surpasses even my ambition.
Take this. Use it to catch the ultimate power.
radio_tower_grunt_deny: The Director is... uh... busy with important business.
No tours today! Come back when you have 7 badges!
radio_tower_grunt_battle: You again? I told you to scram!
Wait... those badges! You're that math genius from the news!
I'm not letting you through to the Director!
flower_shop_intro: Welcome to the Goldenrod Flower Shop!
Our flowers are blooming beautifully today.
flower_shop_reward: Oh! You defeated Whitney? That's amazing!
You'll need this to get past that strange wiggling tree on Route 36.
It hates being watered, so be ready for a battle!

intro: ...You got a Pokemon at the lab. What a waste.
A wimp like you doesn't deserve it.
...Don't you get what I'm saying?
Well, I too have a good Pokemon. I'll show you what I mean!

requirements.fail_text: The Gym Leader, Falkner, is currently mediating at the top of the Sprout Tower. You must defeat Elder Li to prove your worth first!

intro: Welcome to the Violet City Gym! I'm Falkner, the Flying-type Gym Leader.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

travel_options.message: Every Unown in the ruins swirls around Arceus... The world goes white. You're somewhere cold.

fail_text: Bugsy is helping Kurt protect the Slowpoke! You must defeat every Rocket Grunt in the Well to bring him back to the Gym.

intro: Welcome to the Azalea Town Gym! I'm Bugsy, the Bug-type Gym Leader.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

intro: Welcome to the Goldenrod City Gym! I'm Whitney, the Normal-type Gym Leader.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

travel_options.message: You board the Magnet Train. It races underground toward Saffron City in Kanto!

lines: Man: Hey, kid! I found this in the Underground, but I never play the slots.
Take it! A Coin Case lets you play at the Game Corner.

fail_text: Morty is at the Burned Tower, searching for the legendary Pokemon. Go and find him there first!
(If your rival beat you there, go back in and battle him again.)

intro: Welcome to the Ecruteak City Gym! I'm Morty, the Flying-type Gym Leader.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

fail_text: Jasmine is at the Lighthouse, caring for the sick Ampharos.
She won't leave its side until it gets medicine from Cianwood.

intro: Welcome to the Olivine City Gym! I'm Jasmine, the Steel-type Gym Leader.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

travel_options.message: You board the S.S. Aqua. The ship sails east across the sea to Kanto...
The ferry sails south for days over warm seas... Land ho! It's Valencia Island!

lines: Sailor: This ferry sails south to the Orange Islands.
It only takes the Champion of both Kanto and Johto. Come back when you've won both!

intro: Welcome to the Cianwood City Gym! I'm Chuck, the Fighting-type Gym Leader.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

fail_text: Something strange is going on in Mahogany. Pryce won't battle while Team Rocket is in town.
Maybe the trouble at the Lake of Rage is connected...

intro: Welcome to the Mahogany Town Gym! I'm Pryce, the Ice-type Gym Leader.
player_won: Your math burned right through my defense.
The path to Blackthorn is frozen solid. Take this.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

intro: Welcome to the Blackthorn City Gym! I'm Clair, the Dragon-type Gym Leader.
player_lost: Don't worry, you'll get it next time.

intro: ...Hold it.
Are you going to take the Pokemon League challenge?
...Don't make me laugh. You're so much weaker than I am.
I'm not like I was before. I now have the best and strongest Pokemon with me!
player_won: ...I haven't given up on becoming the greatest Trainer...
I'm going to find out why I can't win and become stronger.
When I do, I will challenge you. And I'll beat you down with all my power.
...Humph! You keep at it until then.
player_lost: ...Humph! I knew it. Go home, the League isn't for you.

lines: Mr. Pokemon: Hm? What's that? A red scale!
Is it from a Gyarados? How fascinating! Would you trade it for this?
It's an Exp. Share! Pokemon that hold it share the experience of battles.
Something red is shining by the shore where the Gyarados was...
It's a scale from the Red Gyarados!

intro: Cutting off tails? It's just business!
Team Rocket is back!
You're meddling in things you don't understand!
Don't get in our way!
player_won: I'll tell the boss about you!

intro: I'm the strongest grunt in the well!
Prepare for trouble!
player_lost: Back to the surface with you!

intro: I am Proton, the scariest of the Rocket Executives!
You think your math can stop us?
I'll show you the true meaning of pain!
player_won: Grr... we don't need these tails anyway!
player_lost: Ha! Your math skills are as weak as these Slowpoke!

SLOWPOKE_WELL.enter_warning: Team Rocket grunts are swarming the well!

intro: The trees are so thick here!
My bugs love the shade!
player_lost: My bugs are the masters of this forest!

intro: You have done well to reach the top.
Let us see if you have the soul of a true trainer!
player_won: Incredible. The pillar shakes in resonance with your math skill!
Take this. It will evolve a Weepinbell into a powerful Victreebel.
player_lost: You must study the ways of the Sprout more deeply.

SPROUT_TOWER.enter_warning: The giant pillar in the center sways gently...

intro: ...You again?
I'm looking for the legendary Pokemon.
Only the strongest trainers deserve them!
That's not you!
I am the last of the sisters.
Let us dance!
player_won: Incredible. The bell resonates with you.

lines: At the summit, a silent Trainer stands in the snow.
done: The summit is quiet. Red has gone.
...But you get the feeling you'll meet again.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Elm's Errand
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Travel to Route 30 to visit Mr. Pokemon. He has a discovery that Prof. Elm needs to see!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Unown Researcher
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Ruins of Alph are mysterious. Catch at least 5 different forms of Unown!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Mystery Egg
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You've met Mr. Pokemon and Oak! Return to the Lab in New Bark Town to show Prof. Elm the Mystery Egg.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Sprout Tower Challenge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Sages of Sprout Tower in Violet City hold a secret power. Defeat Elder Li to prove your worth.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Taking Flight
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Falkner at the Violet City Gym. His Flying-type Pokemon soar high—use your math to bring them down!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Slowpoke Rescue
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Rocket is cutting off Slowpoke tails in Azalea Town! Stop them at the Slowpoke Well.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Bugging Out
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With the Well cleared, Bugsy is back at the Azalea Gym. Defeat his scuttling team for the Hive Badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Weird Tree
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A strange tree is blocking Route 36. Visit Goldenrod City to find a way to make it move.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Plain Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Whitney at the Goldenrod Gym is tougher than she looks! Defeat her Miltank to earn your third badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Shadows of Ecruteak
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Explore the Burned Tower in Ecruteak City. Legends say three beastly Pokemon are slumbering in the basement.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Fog Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Morty can see things others cannot. Use your logic to navigate the Ecruteak Gym and defeat his Ghost-types.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lighthouse Rescue
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Jasmine's Ampharos is ill! Travel across the sea to Cianwood City to fetch the Secret Potion.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Storm Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: While in Cianwood, challenge Chuck at the Gym. His Fighting-type Pokemon will test your math stamina!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Mineral Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Amphy is cured! Return to Olivine City and challenge Jasmine. Her Steel-type Pokemon have a rock-solid defense.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Rage at the Lake
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Something is wrong at the Lake of Rage north of Mahogany Town. Investigate the rumor of a Red Gyarados.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Glacier Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Pryce is a master of Ice-type Pokemon. Keep a cool head and defeat him at the Mahogany Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Rising Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Clair of Blackthorn City won't accept your strength easily. Defeat her and pass the test in the Dragon's Den.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Conquer the League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Johto journey ends at the Indigo Plateau. Defeat the Elite Four and become the Johto Champion!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Legend of Mt. Silver
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You are the Champion, but a greater challenge awaits. Brave the heights of Mt. Silver to find the legendary trainer Red.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ruins of Alph
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The stones here hum with a strange frequency. Catch different forms of Unown to unlock the ruins' secrets.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Union Cave Mystery
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: On Fridays, a rare Pokemon is said to appear in the deepest part of Union Cave. Have you found Lapras yet?

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Karate King
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Deep inside Mt. Mortar, the Karate King awaits a challenger. Defeat him to receive a rare Fighting-type Pokemon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: National Upgrade
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Visit Prof. Oak in Pallet Town after becoming Champion. He has a major upgrade for your Pokedex!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Kanto Challenge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With your National Dex in hand, the gyms of Kanto are waiting. Head to Pewter City to find Brock!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Johto Bound
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Visit Route 26 via Indigo Plateau to begin your journey into the Johto region.
